verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Hummingbird's REST-style APIs (Alerts, Case, Case import, filing) and API keys. It never mentions an official SDK or client library in any language. An HTTP API is a developer building block, not an official SDK, so it earns no credit here, and the OpenAPI probe found no spec at any candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Hummingbird provides a Case API for creating or updating cases.
